watchFor: 量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。
量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度。
標記畫面中未展示、仍需額外量測的界面。
watchForEn: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks.
Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties.
Identify interfaces not shown that still require measurement.
videos.before: 先寫下本課的圖像判讀問題：量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。
videos.beforeEn: Write the visual-reading question for this course: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks.
videos.after: 完成觀察工作單，列出影片未能證明的三件事，並為每一件指定量測或來源。
videos.afterEn: Complete the worksheet. List three claims not established by the video and specify a measurement or source for each.

watchFor: 把光源、導光、調變與偵測視為不同功能。

影片是早期平台導覽；現在的選項應查閱官方平台頁。
watchForEn: Separate the functions of light generation, guidance, modulation and detection.
Choose the material platform, design kit and packaging constraints together.
The video is an early platform overview; consult the official platform page for current options.

videos.before: 先問：「自發與受激：模型與設計」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。

courses.overview: 由光子對、光譜純度與符合計數延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend photon pairs, spectral purity and coincidence counting to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 矽光子頻率梳
related.why: 兩課共用色散、腔增強與四波混頻。
related.whyEn: Both use dispersion, cavity enhancement and four-wave mixing.
related.transfer: 兩課共用色散、腔增強與四波混頻。
related.transferEn: Both use dispersion, cavity enhancement and four-wave mixing.
related.difference: 自發量子光需符合與干涉證據，經典頻梳重點是功率、相位雜訊與頻率穩定。
related.differenceEn: Spontaneous quantum light needs coincidences/interference; classical combs emphasize power, phase noise and frequency stability.
practice: 把相同頻率圖換成兩種不同量測鏈。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Turn the same frequency diagram into two different measurement chains.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

courses.summary: 光子晶片量子光源以光子對、光譜純度與符合計數連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips links device physics and system validation through photon pairs, spectral purity and coincidence counting. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以光子對、光譜純度與符合計數比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through photon pairs, spectral purity and coincidence counting, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 高純度矽光子對光源研究
history.text: Nature Communications / research authors 的「矽量子光子高純度自發光子源」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Nature Communications / research authors: Near-ideal spontaneous photon sources in silicon quantum photonics provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把光子對、光譜純度與符合計數放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts photon pairs, spectral purity and coincidence counting within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
